messages.text: Where is my order? Order #····, email (email hidden)
Handed to the team · RMA approval needs JD or Georges; still undecided since Nov 4.

Morning, Rob. Your KBOX (serial GS-10120092, order Shop····) was delivered October 29. The warranty decision still hasn't been made, and I'm sorry. You've been waiting on it since November 4.

I've put it back at the top of the team's list. They're offline right now and pick it up today at 10am ET. Their answer will be posted here and sent to your email, so you don't need to keep the chat open. They already have your photos, readings and serial, so you don't need to send anything again.

Where's JD. He was supposed to be in touch. I know you said that yesterday and still nothing. I will pack it up & return it if no clearcut discussions.                 Im shocked. I was told everyday someone is on it & stay put. Come on, this is not professional at all. Since the only way to stay up front is on it & stay put. Coming to fix this is to send it out today any so ill have it ready to ship, if no one tells me Ill ship to you. This has nothing to do with the miner. This is a customer failure & a huge waste of time. & Time is mor valuable than gold. God I hope there are people to follow as requested?

You're right, Rob. You were told every day that someone would be in touch, and nobody was. That's not good enough, and I'm sorry.

I've asked for a person to contact you today, for an approved return and a clear plan. The team comes online at 10am ET. Their answer will be posted here and sent to your email.

Packing it up now is fine. Please don't ship it yet, though. A box that arrives without our prepaid label and its return reference can't be matched to you at the warehouse.
The next thing that happens is everyone left & some will be in touch only will be in touch after ten!!?? 10:00

Yes, Rob. It's 7:43 here, and nobody from the team is in until 10am ET. I won't pretend otherwise. Your case is the first thing on their list when they log on, flagged as needing a person to deal with you today. Their answer will be posted in this chat and sent to your email.

If you want to try JD before then, Discord is your best shot: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, mention @nullhashrate. Until then, keep the KBOX packed but don't ship it.
I don't think this is right blowing smoke Up My A** for days & days. I already did that, is JD the only other person who works here?

No, Rob. JD handles the hardware, and Georges and Abel run the store. One of them has to approve a warranty return. I'm the team's automated first line, so I can't approve it myself, and that's why you've been going in circles with me. I'm sorry for that.

I've told them this needs a real person today, not another holding message. They're in at 10am ET, and their answer will be posted here and sent to your email. Your case is packed and waiting, and so is the return reference: Shop····.

I have a hard time believing this. You said that before. Scammers do that & hope you just go away. I cannot sit hear waiting for this JD GUY?  Really, this is the 3rd time, is there actually a JD person or someone who can really do something. Every day goes by I miss my shot at a block. a compete company would do this. I Have Parkinson's an now I get to put up you?? So hard to get the truth, Like when will my magic miner ever ship. company does not you. I was self employed for 25 years. I know he can get back to me. Is it only you and JD Who work there?

Rob, I'm sorry. Dealing with this on top of Parkinson's isn't fair, and you've had more than enough holding messages.

They're real people. Georges is a co-founder, Abel runs the store with him, and JD handles the hardware. Your case is flagged to all three as needing a person to contact you today. They're in at 10am ET, and their answer will be posted here and sent to your email.

Your Magic M. 40T, on order Shop····, ships December 7. Tracking is emailed the moment it leaves.
Do it befor the meeting. Like now?

I wish I could, Rob, but I can't. The return label can only be issued once one of them approves the return, and I don't have that approval. I won't pretend I do.

What I can promise is that your case is waiting for them when they log on at 10am ET, flagged as needing a real person today. You don't need to sit here. Their answer will be posted in this chat and sent to your email. Keep the KBOX packed and it'll be ready to go the moment the label comes through.
KD BOX really. nI get dumber everyday

You're not getting dumber, Rob. That mix-up was ours. Last week we confused your GekkoScience KBOX with a Goldshell KD Box, which is a completely different machine. Your case is filed correctly now: the GekkoScience KBOX on order Shop····, serial GS-10120092, rated for 22 TH/s and reading under 1. That's exactly what the team will see when they log on at 10am ET.
